## India: Regulatory Updates & Implementation

India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA) is now fully operational, following the IT Minister's confirmation that the accompanying Rules have been finalized and are set for imminent publication. This marks a critical milestone, activating the comprehensive data privacy framework that will revolutionize enforcement across the country. MeitY Secretary S. Krishnan further underscored the government's firm stance, stating there would be no extensions for DPDPA compliance deadlines, including for startups.

MeitY has also issued a "Removal of Difficulties" Order 2026, providing crucial clarifications on initial compliance hurdles under the DPDPA. This order aims to streamline understanding of consent mechanisms and data audit requirements for Data Fiduciaries as they navigate the new regime. In a related development, IDfy won the MeitY–NeGD DPDP Innovation Challenge, highlighting government efforts to foster technological solutions for privacy enforcement.
